purpose: functional verification of per-sandbox sizes on KVM; the start times are the check's own stopwatch and not a benchmark

cases.name: without a size, a sandbox is the template's
with cpuCount 2 and memoryMB 1024 it has them, and its record says so
paused and resumed it keeps its size, and a fork of it has it too

detail.snapshot_refused: sandbox sbx-efc448e78f4c4bd6b742 is a size of its own and was booted, and such a sandbox cannot be checkpointed; it can be paused

cases.name: its usage counts its own vCPUs and memory
asking for the template's own size is no change
a size that cannot be is refused, and nothing is made

detail.no processors: cpuCount 0: between 1 and 24, this host's CPUs
detail.more processors than the host has: cpuCount 4096: between 1 and 24, this host's CPUs
detail.too little memory: memoryMB 128: an even number from 256 to 65536
detail.an odd amount of memory: memoryMB 1025: an even number from 256 to 65536
detail.too much memory: memoryMB 1048576: an even number from 256 to 65536
